segments.text: Gummy grabs a steaming hot pot handle.
His hand snaps back in a flash.
But the ouch feeling comes after.
Nerves in his fingertip fire off a danger signal.
The signal skips the brain and switches paths in his spine.
It goes straight to his arm muscle: pull back, now.
The same signal reaches the brain - and only then it hurts.
This quick response is called a spinal reflex.
That's exactly what just happened at the stove.
The hand pulls away before the pain is even felt.
